id.description: UUID of the approval queue entry to approve or reject.

decided_by.description:
Who decided, as **verified by the MCP middleware** — never the caller.

`mcp_auth_middleware` overwrites whatever arrives here with the identity
behind the presented token, so a caller cannot name someone else. It is
`Option` because the middleware leaves it unset when nothing identifies
a caller (dev mode, no Cedar), and an unattributable decision is refused
rather than recorded against a placeholder: this value becomes § 20
Abs. 1 EnWG parity evidence and a GoBD record.

antwort_code.description:
The EBD Antwortcode, when the entry does not carry a frozen answer —
an escalated entry, or any refusal.

antwort_tree.description: The Entscheidungsbaum the code is resolved in (e.g. `E_0622`).

antwort_codeliste.description: The Codeliste DE 1131, where the MIG carries one.

bemerkung.description: `FTX+ACB` Erläuterung; also the Begründung of a refusal with no code.

bilanzkreis.description:
The Bilanzkreis an E/G Zustimmung names, where the entry lists
`bilanzkreis` among the facts it still needs.

enfg.description:
The Grundlage nach EnFG on a Strom 55014: `ZG0`, `ZG1` or
`ZF9+<Grund der Privilegierung ZU5…ZV3>`, where the entry lists `enfg`
among the facts it still needs.

malos.description:
MaLo-IDs to keep, at most 200 (any when empty). `pids` or `malos`
names at least one.

heute_faellig.description:
Of those, the ones whose Frist ends from now to the end of the
Europe/Berlin day; a Frist already past is `list_overdue_processes`'.

heute_frueheste.description: The earliest of those Fristen, RFC 3339 in UTC.

process_id.description: UUID of the process (from the `subject` field of the CloudEvent).

period.description: Billing month in `YYYY-MM` format (default: current month).

antwortfrist_abgelaufen.description:
The GPKE / GeLi Gas Lieferantenwechsel reporting its own Antwortfrist
lapse — not an APERAK delivery window.

frist_breached.description:
Processes past their business Antwortfrist (`deadline_at`) without
closing, or closed after it.

with_published_frist.description:
The denominator of `frist_compliance_rate`: a small one means the
month is mostly unmeasured, which a rate near 1.0 hides.

frist_compliance_rate.description:
`1 − frist_breached / with_published_frist`; `None` when nothing in
the month carries a published Frist — never 0.

avg_cycle_time_hours.description: Mean hours from start to end; `None` when nothing has closed.

p95_cycle_time_hours.description: 95th-percentile hours from start to end; `None` when nothing has closed.

deadline_at.description: When the business Antwortfrist ends, RFC 3339 in UTC.

deadline_source.description: The Festlegung the deadline came from.

erc_code.description: The APERAK error code, set only when an APERAK refused a message.

antwort_code.description:
The Antwortcode the counterparty's business answer carried
(`STS+E01` on a UTILMD, `AJT` on an ORDRSP).

antwort_codeliste.description: The tree or Codeliste that answer named for its code.

days.description: The window, in days back from now.

antwortfrist_abgelaufen.description:
A lapsed Antwortfrist the workflow reported: not an ending, the
answer can still arrive.

frist_breached.description: Past their business Antwortfrist without closing, or closed after it.

stp_rate.description:
`completed / ended`, rounded to four places; `None` when nothing
ended in the window — no rate, not a zero one.

FreigabeArt.description: Whether the answer is already decided.

oneOf.description:
The module decided the answer and froze it; approving dispatches exactly
[`Freigabe::antwort`], and a code stated beside it is refused.

No answer was decided: the person states it, from
[`Freigabe::codes_freigeben`] or [`Freigabe::codes_ablehnen`].

Antwort.description: The decided answer a held entry is approved with.

ebd.description: The tree the code was resolved in, when one is known.

bedeutung.description:
The BDEW's wording for `code` in `ebd`; `None` when the tree does not
publish it — never a guess from another tree.

CodeAuswahl.description: The codes an answer of one cluster may carry, and the tree they come from.

codes.description: Every code of that tree in the cluster, in the catalogue's order.

CodeBedeutung.description: One code with the BDEW's own wording for it in its tree.

bedeutung.description: The wording the Entscheidungsbaum prints beside it.

Fakt.description: A fact a decision states beside its code, under the body key `feld`.

bezeichnung.description: What it is, with the segment it rides.

werte.description:
The values the segment admits; empty where the value is free text (a
Bilanzkreis is the LF's own code).

wert.description: What the decision sends — a code, or a number written as text.

id.description: The queue entry — what approve / reject address.

process_id.description: The market process the decision answers.

pid.description: BDEW Prüfidentifikator of the inbound message.

malo_id.description: The Marktlokation (the location for an ESA order), where there is one.

marktrolle.description: The Marktrolle the answer is dispatched under (`NB`, `LF`, `MSB`).

grund.description: Why the entry needs a person, with the Antwortfrist it runs against.

antwort.description: The frozen answer of a held entry.

codes_freigeben.description:
The codes approving is stated with — an escalation's Zustimmungen.
`None` when approving needs no code: a held entry goes as frozen.

codes_ablehnen.description:
The codes rejecting is stated with: the Ablehnungen, or — overriding a
held Ablehnung — the Zustimmungen, because rejecting a held answer
sends the other cluster. `None` when the refusal carries no code.

fakten_freigeben.description:
The facts approving states beside the code, where the entry's own did
not resolve — the Bilanzkreis, Versorgungsart, Abrechnungsintervall or
Grundlage nach EnFG of an E/G Zustimmung. Empty when there are none to
state.

fakten_ablehnen.description:
The same for rejecting — a held E/G Ablehnung is overridden by the
Bestätigung.

expires_at.description: The business Antwortfrist less an hour of headroom, RFC 3339 in UTC.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default 30).

stp_rate.description:
Accepted over accepted and refused decisions, 0.0–1.0; `None` when
none was decided in the window — no rate, not a zero one.

window_days.description: The window, in days back from now.

compliant.description: `false` only when a rate exists and falls below `target`.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default 90 — §20 EnWG audit window).

malos.description:
MaLo-IDs to keep, at most 200 (any when empty). `pids` or `malos`
names at least one.

ProcessRow.description: One open process with its Frist.

deadline_at.description: When the Antwortfrist ended, RFC 3339 in UTC.

deadline_source.description: The Festlegung the deadline came from.

prozesse.description: The earliest Frist first; those without one last.

weiter.description: Pass as `nach` for the next page; absent on the last.

ProcessRow.description: One open process with its Frist.

deadline_at.description: When the Antwortfrist ended, RFC 3339 in UTC.

deadline_source.description: The Festlegung the deadline came from.

saturated.description: At least `limit` were waiting: `count` is a floor, not the total.

limit.description: The most rows one call returns.
At most this many entries (default 50, at most 200).

marktrolle.description:
Only the entries answered under this Marktrolle (`NB`, `LF`, `MSB`);
every role's when absent.
